name: A list of primitives replaces the whole list

testCases.name: strings into numbers
testCases.comment: The frontend converts each item to the item type and writes [4, 5]. The backend deserializes the list with System.Text.Json, which does not read numbers from strings, keeps the previous value and logs a warning.

testCases.name: numbers into strings
testCases.comment: The frontend converts each item to the item type and writes ["4", "5"]. The backend deserializes the list with System.Text.Json, which does not read strings from numbers, keeps the previous value and logs a warning.
